senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (अर्थयते sometimes -ति)
To ask or beg.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Rich.
2 Learned.
m. (-र्थः)
1 Wealth, property, substance.
2 Meaning, signification.
3 Thing.
4 Fruit, consequence.
5 Prohibition.
6 A material substance or object of sense.
7 Cause, origin.
8 Request, asking, begging.
9 Kind, sort, manner.
10 Well, well being.
11 (In law) A suit, an action.
E.
ऋ to go, and थन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Producing or yielding wealth, what enriches.
E.
अर्थ, and कर what makes, also similar compounds, as अर्थकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं,) अर्थकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) and अर्थजनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं,) &c.

m. (-मः)
Avarice, desire of wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and काम desire.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Significant, meaning.
E.
अर्थ with गुरु heavy, ईयसुन superlative aff.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Wasteful, extravagant.
E.
अर्थ, and घ्न who or what destroys.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Wise, discriminating, understanding the various significations of a word, &c.
E.
अर्थ meaning, and ज्ञ who knows.

ind.
According to the sense.
E.
तसि added to अर्थ.

n. (-त्त्वं)
Truth, the real object, nature or cause of any thing.
E.
अर्थ, and तत्त्व truth.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Liberal, munificent.
2 Compliant, favourable.
E.
अर्थ wealth or object, and द who or what gives. Also similar compounds, as अर्थदायक, अर्थदायिन् and अर्थदातृ, &c.

n. (-णं)
Waste, prodigality, extravagance.
E.
अर्थ, and दूषण spoiling.

f. (-ना)
Begging, asking.
E.
अर्थ to ask, and युच् aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 KUVERA, the Hindu PLUTUS.
2 A king.
E.
अर्थ wealth, and पति lord.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 A figure of speech, a quibble, the use of one word in a double sense.
2 An inference from circumstances.
E.
अर्थ, and आपत्ति gaining.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Intent on gaining wealth.
2 Parsimonious, niggardly.
E.
अर्थ, and पर intent.

m. (-गः)
1 Application of wealth, as to trade, usury, &c.
2 The profession of usury.
E.
अर्थ, and प्रयोग application.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Acquisition of wealth.
2 Attainment of an object.
E.
अर्थ, and प्राप्ति gaining.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
A servant who has high wages.
E.
अर्थ, and भृत maintained.

m. (-दः)
Distinction, difference of meaning.
E.
अर्थ meaning, and भेद dividing.

m. (-भः)
Acquisition of wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and लाभ acquiring.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Greedy of wealth, covetous, niggardly.
E.
अर्थ, and लुब्ध desirous.

m. (-शः)
A little wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and लेश a little.

m. (-भः)
Avarice, desire of wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and लोभ desire.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Wealthy, rich.
2 Significant, having sense or meaning.
3 Designed, intentional, having an object.
E.
अर्थ, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-दः)
1 Praise, eulogium.
2 Declaration of purpose or object, speech or expression having a certain object, as स्तुत्यर्थवादः speech implying praise, निन्दार्थवादः speech implying censure.
3 Amplification.
E.
अर्थ substance, thing, and वाद speaking.

n. (-नं)
One of the six exercises of the understanding, the comprehension of meanings.
E.
अर्थ meaning, import, and विज्ञान knowledge.

mfn. (-वित् or -विद्)
Sagacious, sensible, wise.
E.
अर्थ, and विद् who knows.

f. (-द्धिः)
Accumulation of wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and वृद्धि increase.

n. (-ल्पं)
Prevarication, evasion, deviation from truth, perversion or disguise of fact.
E.
अर्थ object, वैकल्प alteration.

m. (-यः)
Expenditure.
E.
अर्थ, and व्यय expenditure.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Liberal in giving and using.
E.
अर्थ wealth, व्यय expense, and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-स्त्रं)
The science of polity or moral and political government.
E.
अर्थ possession, property, and शास्त्र institutes of a science.

n. (-चं)
1 Honesty.
2 Acquisition of wealth.
E.
अर्थ purpose or wealth, शौच purity.

m. (-हः)
1 Accumulation of wealth.
2 A treasure.
E.
अर्थ, and संग्रह a collection.

n. (-नं)
1 Accumulation of wealth.
2 A treasury.
E.
अर्थ, and संस्थान assemblage.

m. (-यः)
Accumulation of wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and सञ्चय heap.

m. (-न्धः)
Connexion of the sense with the word or sentence.
E.
अर्थ, and सम्बन्ध connexion.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Effected by wealth.
2 Successful, one whose aim is accomplished.
E.
अर्थ, and सिद्ध accomplished.

f. (-द्धिः)
Success.
E.
अर्थ, and सिद्धि accomplishment.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Inheriting or taking wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and हर who takes. So अर्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि).

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Poor.
2 Failing, disappointed.
3 Unmeaning, nonsensical.
E.
अर्थ, and हीन wanting. So अर्थशून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं).
E.
अर्थ, and शून्य empty.

m. (-मः)
1 Receipt or collection of property.
2 Acquisition of wealth.
E.
अर्थ wealth, and आगम coming.

m. (-रः)
Stewardship, treasurership, charge of money or property.
E.
अर्थ, and अधिकार superintendence.

m. (-री)
A treasurer, a paymaster.
E.
अर्थ, and अधिकारिन् superintendent.

n. (-रं)
1 Difference of meaning or purport.
2 Another or second sense.
3 Opposite or antithetical meaning.
E.
अर्थ, and अन्तर difference.

m. (-सः)
Antithesis.
E.
अर्थान्तर, and न्यास position.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Rich.
2 Significant.
E.
अर्थ wealth, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
1 One who solicits wealth.
2 One endeavouring to gain any object.
E.
अर्थ, and अर्थिन who seeks or solicits.

m. (-कः)
1 A crier, a watchman, a minstrel, a servant whose duty it is to announce by song or music, fixed periods of the day, or those of getting up and of repose, &c.
2 A beggar, a solicitor.
E.
अर्थि a rich man, and क from के to call or sound.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Wise.
2 Rich.
3 Significant.
E.
अर्थ and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Asked, begged, sought.
E.
अर्थ to ask, क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
Asking, begging. Also n. (-त्वं)
E.
तल् or त्व added to अर्थिन्.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
1 One who asks or begs for any thing.
2 One who seeks to effect or gain a purpose or object.
m. (-र्थी)
1 A servant.
2 A follower, a companion or partisan.
3 A plaintiff, a prosecutor.
4 A beggar, a petitioner.
E.
अर्थ asking, &c. इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Acquiring wealth.
E.
अर्थ, and उपार्ज्जन acquiring.

n. (-ष्म)
Wealth, the condition of being wealthy.
E.
अर्थ, and उष्मन् warmth. So, anglice, a warm man.

mfn. (-र्थ्यः-र्थ्या-र्थ्यं)
1 Intelligent, wise.
2 Wealthy.
3 Right, proper.
4 Fit to be asked or sought.
n. (-र्थ्यं)
Red chalk.
E.
अर्थ and यत् aff.
